text: Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant High school academic transcript It must be notarized photocopy High school graduate certificate (notarized photocopy) Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.
